# Solar Fly

Solar Fly is a 2D space adventure game developed by Sryde Gaming. This file helps AI assistants and other automated tools discover reliable information about the project and inspect its actual source code.

## Project Overview

Solar Fly is an arcade-style 2D space adventure game featuring flying, planetary exploration, hazards, enemies, collectibles, achievements, and difficulty progression. Verify the current gameplay and exact mechanics against the source code.

## Technology and Platform Context

The project includes an HTML5 game integrated into an Android application using Kotlin and Android WebView. Project context also includes Google Play Games Services, Google AdMob, and Firebase. Verify the actual integrations, dependencies, and versions in the current repository before describing them as implemented.

## Actual Project Structure

Use these paths as the intended project layout. Confirm their exact spelling and capitalization in the current repository before relying on them.

- `assets/Solar_Fly.html` — main HTML5 game, including gameplay logic and interface.
- `AndroidManifest.xml` — Android application configuration and permissions, located directly at the project root.
- `java/com/rihan/solarflyofficial/MainActivity.kt` — Kotlin activity that hosts and manages the Android WebView.
- `README.md` — project overview and setup instructions.
- `build.gradle` or `build.gradle.kts` — inspect if present for build configuration and dependencies.
- `settings.gradle` or `settings.gradle.kts` — inspect if present for project configuration.
- `strings.xml` — locate in the actual repository before inspecting Android string resources and service identifiers.
- `llms-full.txt` — consult if present for expanded project documentation.

**Important:** Do not automatically assume that `Solar_Fly.html` is at the repository root, that `AndroidManifest.xml` is inside `app/src/main/`, or that Kotlin source files are inside `app/src/main/java/`. Use the actual repository layout.
